claim_boundary.field_level: P2 adaptive FEM with LINEAR soft-iron (mu_r 4000) poles and yoke and recoil-remanence SmCo-like magnets; two nested levels (screening configuration of the fem_reference qualification, not the three-level NUMERICAL_P2_QUALIFIED chain); not hardware-valid
claim_boundary.paper_admission: NOT in scope of this campaign; the result records what a numerical-screening admission would state
claim_boundary.what_is_confirmed_or_disconfirmed: the L1a cusp topology (cell count, cusp axial positions) and the L1a Koch-rho HEMP-like classification of the 15 designs under a material-aware field
claim_boundary.what_is_not_claimed: saturation, B-H nonlinearity, temperature, plasma, mirror probability, thrust, efficiency, or any design recommendation

classification_statement: Independent quadratic-FEM magnetostatic reference with linear soft-iron poles / yoke and recoil-remanence magnets, sampled into the cusp topology search v3.1 definition. It confirms or disconfirms the L1a (linear-vacuum equivalent-current FDM) cusp topology of fifteen designs. It is not hardware validation, not a B-H-curve model, not a plasma, mirror-probability, thrust or efficiency claim.

comparison.count_agreement: STRICT: P2 wall_cusp_count == L1a wall_cusp_count (and cell_count). BOUNDARY-TOLERANT: strict, or every unmatched cusp on either side lies within boundary_ambiguity_tolerance_m (0.25 mm) of a straight-section end (a boundary classification, the v3.1 wall_cusp_count_change_is_boundary_classification concept)
comparison.cusp_position_tolerance_rule: tolerance_m(design) = max(wall_radius_m / bore_elements, l1a_dz_m) = max(r_w / 8, 0.0004514): one level-0 P2 bore element (two level-1 bore elements), never below the L1a axial grid step; 0.45-0.53 mm over the 15 designs
comparison.l1a_reference: the sealed sweep-v3 design record's ACCEPTED map (80 x 144 L1a grid, dr 0.375 mm, dz 0.4514 mm) characterization and descriptors
comparison.matching: cusps (and axis nulls inside the L1a window) are matched by the v3.1 sorted nearest-neighbour bijection (_match_sorted) within the design's tolerance; unmatched cusps on either side are reported
comparison.p2_discretisation_sensitivity: compare_resolutions(coarse level-0 map, accepted level-1 map) at the stability tolerance: max axis-null and wall-intersection shifts; reported and used to judge whether the L1a-P2 shift exceeds the P2 discretisation scale
comparison.p2_reference: the level-1 material-aware map sampled at 1x (ACCEPTED P2 map)
comparison.rho: Koch rho readings (conservative / downstream / upstream / wall, sweep-v3 descriptors.cusp_rho_table) on the P2 map; hemp_like_all_cusps under P2; per matched cusp rho_conservative P2 / L1a
comparison.sampling_stability: compare_resolutions(accepted 1x sampling, refined 2x sampling of the same level-1 solution) at the stability tolerance 0.25 mm (binding integrity gate, as in v3.1)
comparison.wall_b_ratio: per matched cusp: P2 wall |B| (at the design's source_strength_scale) / L1a wall |B|; per design: peak wall |B| over the straight dielectric (400 samples per cell, v3.1 _wall_max) P2 / L1a; also the unscaled P2 value and the axis |B_z| peak ratio

definition_v3_import.must_equal_v3_1: experiment.policy_from raises if these parameters differ from the v3.1 protocol
definition_v3_import.source: experiments.cusp_topology_search_v3_1.topology (characterize_map, compare_resolutions, tracing_grid, bicubic_field) and experiments.l1a_geometry_sweep_v3.descriptors (design_descriptors: Koch rho readings, HEMP-like flag, wall harmonics, profiles) imported unchanged; protocol.json#definition_v3 of cusp topology search v3.1 (result commit cec47f12) is the definition authority and is bound by hash in dependency_source_sha256

hemp_like_v3.identity: each design is rebuilt from the preregistered sweep-v3 Sobol design (seed 20260903, index) with the sweep-v3 builder; geometry / source / config / case hashes must equal the sealed sweep-v3 design authorities; the L1a reference is the sealed sweep-v3 design record whose bytes must match the sweep-v3 manifest
hemp_like_v3.representative_rule: first of the list (three-stage, x_w 2.74), smallest x_w (015, 2.25), largest x_w (036, 3.24), five-stage four-cusp (106)
hemp_like_v3.rule: a design is HEMP-like iff it has at least one wall cusp inside the straight dielectric and every such cusp has rho_conservative >= 1.5 (the sealed catalogue's hemp_like_rule)
hemp_like_v3.source: l1a_geometry_sweep_v3/results/artifacts/cusp-cell-catalogue-v3.json (schema 1.1.0), entries with set_id == sobol_v3 and hemp_like_all_cusps == true, in catalogue order; byte-bound to the sweep-v3 results manifest

execution.cpu_budget_note: one P2 design at a time (resource policy one_design_at_a_time); 1-5 min per design; wall-clock budget 1.5 h; the GPU is never touched
execution.determinism_rule: each design's record is a pure function of (protocol, design identity, fem_reference implementation); the main process re-solves, re-samples and re-characterizes the replay design and requires byte-identical canonical comparison payloads

binding_integrity.all_declared_designs_resolved: every declared design rebuilt, identity-proven, solved on both P2 levels, sampled and characterized (no exclusions)
binding_integrity.axis_window_reproduced: every P2 map was searched on the sealed L1a axis window (contained in the sampling grid with the v3.1 margin)
binding_integrity.determinism_replay: re-solving, re-sampling and re-characterizing the replay design in the main process reproduces the worker's canonical comparison payload bytes exactly
binding_integrity.every_null_converged: definition v3: every axis null in the accepted, refined and coarse P2 maps converged, X-type, classifications agree
binding_integrity.every_trace_terminates_cleanly: definition v3: every separatrix terminates as wall or domain_z in every P2 map
binding_integrity.every_wall_trace_flux_consistent: definition v3: every wall-reaching trace agrees with the flux root within 5e-5 m in every P2 map
binding_integrity.hash_bindings: protocol, experiment code, dependency sources, field pipeline sources and sealed-source identities equal the preregistered authorities
binding_integrity.identity_proven: every design's geometry / source / config / case hashes equal the sealed sweep-v3 design authorities and the L1a record bytes equal the sweep-v3 manifest
binding_integrity.ram_policy_respected: peak process RSS over the campaign <= 0.4 x free physical RAM at campaign start; every level's allocation preflight passed
binding_integrity.sampling_stability: same axis-null count, same wall-reaching count, |dz_k| and |dz_c| <= 0.25 mm between the 1x and the 2x sampling of the level-1 solution for every design
binding_integrity.solver_converged_all_levels: GATE (a): every design's level-0 and level-1 P2 solves report converged = true at relative_tolerance 2e-10 within 16000 iterations, and level 1 was evaluated within the RAM budget / DOF cap (no ResourceBlockedError)

cusp_count_unchanged.estimand: fraction of the 15 designs whose BOUNDARY-TOLERANT wall-cusp count agreement holds (strict fraction reported alongside)

cusp_position_shift.estimand: over every matched cusp of every design: max |z_c(P2) - z_c(L1a)| / tolerance_m(design); passes iff every matched cusp shifts by at most its design tolerance AND every design's cusp matching is a bijection; median, mean and max shift in mm and in tolerance units are reported

hemp_like_preserved.estimand: fraction of the 15 designs that remain HEMP-like (rho_conservative >= 1.5 at every wall cusp) under the material-aware P2 map; reported with the per-cusp rho ratio P2 / L1a; the wall |B| ratio band [0.5, 2.0] is descriptive, not a gate

confirmation.statement: pass/fail verdicts on the confirmation question, predeclared here; their outcome classifies the result as CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED / DISCONFIRMED and never makes the campaign invalid (a disagreement is a recorded finding)
confirmation.verdict_rule: CONFIRMED iff (b) and (c) pass; PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED iff exactly one passes; DISCONFIRMED iff neither passes

reported_not_binding: HEMP-like preserved fraction and per-cusp rho ratios

outputs.dataset: artifacts/confirmation-dataset.json (+ .csv): one row per design with the L1a and P2 topology, the matched cusps and shifts, the wall |B| and rho ratios, the P2 solve evidence and the gates
outputs.design_records: artifacts/designs/hemp_like_v3/<design_id>.json (full P2 characterizations of the coarse / accepted / refined maps, descriptors, comparison, timing)
outputs.fields: artifacts/fields/hemp_like_v3/<design_id>.json.gz (accepted P2 sampled grid: r, z, psi, B_r, B_z)

adaptivity.statement: level 0 = graded initial mesh; level 1 = Dorfler union marking (residual, flux jump, QoI proxy at theta 0.5) with red refinement and the 1.3 gradation closure (in practice near-uniform: ~4x DOFs), initial guess prolonged from level 0. Level 1 is the ACCEPTED material-aware map; level 0 is the COARSE map whose difference to level 1 is the recorded P2 discretisation sensitivity. A third level (0.4-1.9M DOFs, up to ~4 GB guard requirement) is excluded by the RAM budget of this session (GPU-side PIC run holds the host; free RAM 4-13 GB) and by the 1 h wall budget.

materials.magnet_remanence_t: synthetic SmCo-like remanence at the reference temperature (checked_synthetic_smco_like_magnet), axial, polarity alternating from first_polarity
materials.statement: linear isotropic mu_r; no saturation, no B-H curve; the pole pieces sit exactly in the inter-magnet gaps and the return yoke outside the shield shell (geometry v1.1 regions pole-XX and return-yoke)
materials.vacuum_like_regions: plasma placeholder, BN dielectric, Al shield, copper anode at mu_r = 1

mesh.statement: fem_reference graded_mesh_geometry: initial bore element r_w / 8, feature element = min(feature width, dielectric) / 3, exterior grading 1.01 per element up to 1.3x, dipole Robin outer boundary at padding 0.5 x characteristic length. The qualification campaign used 4 feature elements; 3 is chosen here because the thin dielectric (0.57-0.87 mm) sets the global element size and the five-stage 25 mm designs reach 188k level-0 DOFs at 4 (level 1 ~750k, outside the RAM budget); at 3 the level-0 mesh is 24k-117k DOFs (survey of all 15 designs before the freeze) and level 1 stays below 470k. The iron poles (>= 0.95 mm) keep >= 3 elements across at level 0 and >= 6 at level 1; the bore keeps 8 / 16.

resources.expected: level 0 24k-117k P2 DOFs (4-40 s), level 1 97k-470k DOFs (0.5-4 min), peak RSS 0.1-0.5 GB per design; the guard's required free RAM at 470k DOFs is ~1.0 GB (probe on design 000 at 4 feature elements: 40,659 / 161,813 DOFs, 7.7 s / 49.1 s, 114 MB RSS)
resources.gpu_not_used: the RTX 5090 is occupied by a PIC plume run (PID 53824) during this campaign; no CUDA / Warp import in the solve path
resources.guard: fem_reference.resource_policy.preflight_level_allocation before every solve with available_bytes = min(0.4 x free physical RAM at campaign start, free RAM now) and maximum_p2_dofs 600000 (the fem_reference policy cap is 1.5M; 600k is the smallest round cap above the 4x red-closure bound of the largest level-0 mesh, 117k); a level whose red-closure upper bound exceeds the cap, or whose preflight fails, raises ResourceBlockedError -> the design is recorded as not evaluated (fails the solver gate); peak RSS of the process is recorded after every solve and must stay below the budget

sampling.axis_window: the sealed L1a record's axis_window_m is used verbatim for every P2 map so both fields are searched on exactly the same axial window; the sampling grid must contain it with the v3.1 margin (2.5 x mesh scale) or the design fails
sampling.statement: the P2 solution is sampled on a regular grid r = 0..r_w in 32 intervals (h = r_w / 32, 0.07-0.13 mm), z from (domain z_min + h0) to (domain z_max - h0) with h0 = r_w / 32 and dz = the largest step <= h giving an integer interval count; psi = r A_phi, B_r = -dA_phi/dz, B_z = A_phi / r + dA_phi/dr (axis: 2 dA_phi/dr); shared-edge nodes average the element traces. The REFINED map is the same level-1 solution sampled at 2x (64 radial intervals, dz / 2): the sampling / interpolation stability check of the v3.1 P2 set. The COARSE map is the level-0 solution sampled at 1x. Every sampled map is post-scaled by the design's L1a source_strength_scale (exact for the linear problem) so L1a and P2 carry the same magnet strength.

solver.backend: numpy CSR PCG (IC0 below 15000 free DOFs, Jacobi above); CPU only, no CUDA, no Warp
solver.package: cft_revival.fem_reference (adapters.graded_mesh_geometry, solver.solve, adaptivity.estimate_indicators / component_dorfler_mark, mesh.refine_mesh, solver.prolong_p2_solution)
solver.statement: the controls of the fem_reference qualification campaign (examples/fem_reference/run_reference_campaign.py: relative_tolerance 2e-10, max_iterations 16000); a solve is converged iff the true residual acceptance holds (FEMResult.diagnostics.converged)

purpose: The L1a geometry sweep v3 (result commit 2cfe8223) found 15 of 128 Sobol designs HEMP-like (Koch rho_conservative >= 1.5 at every wall cusp) while its claim boundary declared the soft-iron pole pieces and yoke source-free vacuum and queued an L1b/P2 confirmation for r_w / L > 0.5 (protocol.json#claim_boundary.l1b_p2_confirmation, status queued_not_run; TWT/PPM review beb4772c section 5.3). This campaign runs that confirmation: for each of the 15 designs the material-aware P2 field is solved (cft_revival.fem_reference, the solver whose divergent-exit-stack chain is NUMERICAL_P2_QUALIFIED), the v3.1 cusp definition is applied verbatim, and the cell count, the cusp axial positions, the wall |B| and the Koch rho are compared with the sealed L1a record. A disagreement is a valid, reportable result.

shakedown.design_rule: smallest x_w (015, three cusps, four stages), largest x_w (036, three stages), the five-stage four-cusp design with the largest x_w (106): the three extremes of the set
prepare_requires: experiment_code_sha256, dependency_source_sha256 and field_pipeline_source_sha256 equal the current sources
shakedown.purpose: Exercise the complete production path (sealed catalogue binding, sweep-v3 rebuild with identity proof, two-level P2 solve with the RAM guard, regular-grid sampling at 1x and 2x, definition-v3 characterization of the coarse / accepted / refined maps on the L1a window, descriptors, L1a comparison, gates, dataset, CSV, publication through the shared ExperimentRuntime into a temporary root, validate_bundle) on REAL designs before the preregistration freeze.

title: Material-aware (adaptive P2 FEM with soft-iron poles and yoke) confirmation of the 15 HEMP-like designs of L1a geometry sweep v3
